subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: After the abortable-delay repair, should Discord retain a channel-level transient retry in addition to the shared fenced reply-session self-heal proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: The mechanical timer defect is clear, but source inspection alone cannot establish whether two recovery layers should intentionally compose or whether the shared session owner should be the sole canonical recovery path.

options.title: Keep Both Scoped Layers
options.body: Retain the narrow Discord retry for transient delivery recovery while using shared self-heal only for persistent repeated conflicts, with proof that the paths compose safely.

options.title: Use Shared Recovery Only
options.body: Remove the Discord retry if shared fenced self-heal reliably prevents the channel-visible message loss without a second recovery loop.

options.title: Land Discord First
options.body: Land the abort-safe Discord mitigation before shared recovery, accepting temporary overlapping recovery design until the lower-level change is decided.

recommendation.title: Keep Both Scoped Layers
recommendation.body: Retain the narrow Discord retry for transient delivery recovery while using shared self-heal only for persistent repeated conflicts, with proof that the paths compose safely.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the recent refactor spanning both the Discord processor and shared initialization boundary, giving him the strongest evidence-backed context for choosing the permanent recovery owner.
